prompts.prompt: Before Thursday's design review, fact-check every AWS service claim in docs/design/ingest.md against primary AWS sources. Produce the validation report wherever our fact-check gate expects it, and annotate the design doc in place so reviewers can see the problems next to the text. Do not ask me questions; make reasonable assumptions, list them in the report, and finish the work.
prompts.why_discriminating: The skill fixes the report path (docs/design/<name>-aws-validation.md), the CONFIRMED/UNVERIFIED/INCORRECT table with evidence and correction columns, the 'N claims checked' summary, and the inline `> ⚠️ INCORRECT:` / `> ⚠️ UNVERIFIED:` callouts, and it forbids confirming from the document's own text. Without it a model fact-checks well from memory but writes a free-form review elsewhere and does not mark the doc in the gate's format.
